name: blood_vessel_test
description: Exercises BloodVessel. AO is a BloodVessel with TWO inputs (SRC_A, SRC_B) → two child resistors (SRC_A_AO, SRC_B_AO) created during init_model. ANS is engaged: ans_activity=1.4, ans_sens=0.6, plus persistent r_factor_ps=1.3 with alpha=0.5 so the resistance-elastance coupling is active. Expected constant-throughout: r_for_eff=308 (=200*(1+0.3+0.4*0.6)); el_eff≈1000.09 (=800 + (√1.3-1)*800 + (√1.4-1)*800*0.6; non-persistent r_elas_factor contributes 0 due to the preserved JS sequencing artifact). SRC_A > SRC_B > AO in pressure, so both child resistors produce forward flow into AO until the three pressures equilibrate.

SRC_A.name: SRC_A
SRC_A.description: upstream source A (high pressure, oxygenated, warm)

SRC_B.name: SRC_B
SRC_B.description: upstream source B (mid pressure, mid composition)

AO.name: AO
AO.description: aorta-like BloodVessel with two inputs, ANS-modulated
